decisions.reason: We would keep the coolant pressure booster system because it is core-adjacent, no clear result shortfall versus aspiration is visible, and our size and slack let us continue backing it.

We would keep the coolant cleaning centrifuge since it fits our established coolant-management business and there is still no strong sign that its performance falls below internal or peer-based aspirations.

We would keep the coolant nozzles line because its modular variants complement broader system sales and a surviving young product line would not be withdrawn without clearer evidence of underperformance.

We would keep the magnetic belt chip conveyor because it builds directly on our established conveying portfolio and our engineering and service capabilities support continued exploitation of the product.

We would keep the hinged belt chip conveyor for now, but its drop risk remains the highest among the products still on the market because adjacent conveyor launches are more exposed to aspiration shortfalls and portfolio reallocation after Product D was withdrawn.
